initialize_backup_runtime_state() {
          python3 -I - "$secret_dir" "$run_key" <<'D069_BACKUP_STATE_DIRECTORY'
        import json, os, re, stat, sys
        descriptors = []
        try:
            secret_path, run_key = sys.argv[1:]
            if not os.path.isabs(secret_path) or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]{0,19}-[1-9][0-9]{0,5}', run_key):
                raise ValueError('identity')
            parts = secret_path.split('/')[1:]
            if not parts or any(part in ('', '.', '..') for part in parts):
                raise ValueError('path')
            uid = os.geteuid()
            flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC
            parent = os.open('/', flags)
            descriptors.append(parent)
            for part in parts:
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
                descriptors.append(child)
                info = os.fstat(child)
                if info.st_uid not in (0, uid) or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) & 0o022:
                    raise ValueError('ancestor')
                parent = child
            info = os.fstat(parent)
            if info.st_uid != uid or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o700:
                raise ValueError('secret-directory')
            try:
                os.mkdir('release-state', 0o700, dir_fd=parent)
                os.fsync(parent)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
            release = os.open('release-state', flags, dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(release)
            info = os.fstat(release)
            if info.st_uid != uid or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o700:
                raise ValueError('release-directory')
            name = 'backup-runtime-' + run_key
            os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=release)
            os.fsync(release)
            state = os.open(name, flags, dir_fd=release)
            descriptors.append(state)
            info = os.fstat(state)
            if info.st_uid != uid or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o700:
                raise ValueError('state-directory')
            os.fsync(state)
            print(json.dumps({'schemaVersion': 1, 'state': 'created', 'executionUid': uid, 'mode': '0700'}))
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            print(json.dumps({'state': 'refused', 'code': 'BACKUP_STATE_DIRECTORY_UNTRUSTED_OR_ALREADY_EXISTS'}), file=sys.stderr)
            raise SystemExit(1)
        finally:
            for descriptor in reversed(descriptors):
                os.close(descriptor)
        D069_BACKUP_STATE_DIRECTORY
        }

        cleanup_backup_runtime() {
          if [ "$backup_runtime_started" -eq 1 ]; then
